d:
For years, I've heard about the communities living in the Appalachian mountains of Eastern Kentucky, so I flew out there by myself, rented a car, and drove across the region. What I discovered will leave you stunned - this is not the America that you know about :)
Hope you have an amazing holiday and end of the year celebration, and I'll see you guys back with some more adventures next year!
